mcq.q: Complete: He ___ (mend) the car since 9 o'clock.
mcq.why: 'Since 9 o'clock' shows an action that is still continuing.

mcq.q: Choose the best word: Trucks carry ___ from the port to the city.
mcq.why: Freight is goods carried by vehicles.

mcq.q: Choose the best word: Old cars ___ a lot of harmful gas.
mcq.why: Cars emit, or send out, gas.

mcq.q: Why is a Maglev train smoother and quieter than a conventional train?
o: It floats above the track instead of rolling on it
mcq.why: No wheels on the rails means less noise and bumping.
